scenarios.mech: Permit government securities lending and borrowing to deploy idle holdings and augment the special repo market.
Adopt the lending framework with narrower initial participation or a longer implementation transition than proposed.

forecasts.notes: An explicit draft and elapsed comment deadline support eventual adoption. General rulemaking timelines leave substantial six-month delay risk. The evidence establishes policy purpose but provides little detail for predicting amendments or publication timing.
